value.rationale: Natural complete classification of an infinite family of normalized quantum-walk transfer problems, resolving both true- and false-twin apex geometries. It gives all-time probability and exact minimum and recurring PST times, plus two opposite effects from one apex edge, a structural contrast with ordinary Laplacian transfer driven by the base order. Not merely a finite example or restatement of a general spectral criterion.
